title: GDS Cyber - CAOE - Staff - AI IT OT Network and Infrastructure Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Staff**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands \& possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge \& experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.


**Professional understanding \& knowledge of\-**
* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate - System Engineer
description:

* Assist in maintaining internal servers, systems, and infrastructure environments.

* Review system logs and report anomalies or potential issues.

title: Senior Network Engineer - WAN - GCS
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title: Senior Network Engineer (WAN) \- GCS**
**Job Summary:**
 The Senior Network Engineer (WAN) within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) is responsible for executing vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, software upgrades, and technical change activities across enterprise WAN infrastructure. The role provides technical leadership for deployment activities, complex troubleshooting, change execution, and service restoration involving Cisco Routing and Switching, Versa SD\-WAN, WAN links, and associated connectivity platforms.
   

  

 The position works with Network Engineering, Network Operations, Information Security, Change Management, Outage Management, Product Owners, vendors, service providers, and other stakeholders to maintain platform currency, deliver remediation programs, and ensure production changes are implemented safely with minimal business disruption.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Drive vulnerability remediation activities across Versa SD\-WAN, Cisco Routing and Switching, and WAN connectivity platforms.
* Perform software and firmware upgrades on Cisco ISR and ASR routers, Catalyst platforms supporting WAN connectivity, Versa SD\-WAN controllers, branch edge devices, and supporting network infrastructure in line with approved engineering standards.
* Review vendor security advisories, software recommendations, defects, and EOS/EOL notices, and translate applicable findings into remediation and lifecycle activities.
* Ensure WAN network devices remain compliant with approved software versions, security standards, operational guidelines, and remediation timelines.
* Manage software lifecycle and platform currency for Cisco routing and switching platforms and Versa SD\-WAN infrastructure.
* Plan and execute code upgrades, patch deployments, configuration updates, platform remediation, technology refresh, and WAN modernization activities.
* Perform pre\-upgrade assessments, compatibility reviews, configuration validation, risk analysis, and post\-upgrade health checks.
* Prepare implementation plans, rollback procedures, validation plans, technical assessments, stakeholder communications, and deployment documentation.
* Create and maintain Change Requests, Change Tasks, implementation records, approvals, technical evidence, and closure documentation in accordance with EY processes.
* Present technical changes during CAB reviews and address implementation, impact, risk, dependency, validation, and recovery considerations.
* Coordinate testing, outage planning, deployment execution, stabilization, and post\-implementation validation across technical teams and stakeholders.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of Versa SD\-WAN overlays, underlay WAN connectivity, routing protocols, and enterprise routing infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving BGP, OSPF, route policies, path selection, WAN failover, VPN services, traffic steering, QoS, and application forwarding policies.
* Diagnose and resolve issues affecting WAN links, ISP circuits, SD\-WAN fabric health, branch connectivity, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
* Work with vendors, carriers, service providers, and internal teams to restore services and resolve complex technical issues.
* Serve as the technical lead for incidents affecting WAN infrastructure, routing platforms, SD\-WAN services, and production upgrade activities.
* Participate in outage calls, major incident bridges, and technical recovery activities; perform root cause analysis and define corrective and preventive actions.
* Support Problem Management by analyzing recurring issues, identifying trends, and driving permanent technical resolutions.
* Lead assigned remediation waves, upgrade deployments, infrastructure refreshes, and network improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate testing, validation, implementation, and stabilization activities, and track technical risks, dependencies, actions, and delivery progress.
* Provide operational feedback, implementation considerations, and technical recommendations for proposed network design changes when requested.
* Maintain implementation procedures, operational runbooks, remediation documentation, software compliance records, upgrade history, and deployment outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, monitoring, analytics, and operational efficiency.
* Provide technical guidance to Associate and Senior Associate engineers and support consistent execution of WAN remediation and lifecycle activities.


**Knowledge \& Competencies Required:**
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Versa SD\-WAN, including Versa Director and Analytics, SD\-WAN overlays, underlay connectivity, traffic steering, and branch edge operations.
* Strong expertise in Cisco routing technologies, including ISR and ASR platforms, and Cisco switching platforms supporting WAN connectivity.
* Advanced understanding of BGP, OSPF, routing policies, route selection, redundancy, VPN services, QoS, and WAN failover.
* Experience troubleshooting WAN links, ISP circuits, branch connectivity, SD\-WAN fabric health, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
* Experience assessing vendor security advisories and delivering vulnerability remediation, firmware lifecycle, patching, and infrastructure upgrade activities.
* Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, impact assessment, and service restoration capabilities.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly Change, Incident, Problem, Risk, and Release Management.
* Ability to prepare implementation plans, rollback procedures, validation plans, technical documentation, and CAB presentations.
* Experience coordinating production deployments, outage windows, vendors, carriers, service providers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Knowledge of network monitoring, observability, analytics, and automation platforms.
* Automation or scripting knowledge using APIs, Python, Ansible, or related tools is desirable.
* Strong ownership, sound technical judgement, risk\-based decision making, and attention to operational safety.
* Good communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and technical leadership skills within a global matrixed environment.
* Willingness to work in a global support model, including rotational shifts and support activities across multiple time zones.
* Flexibility to support planned maintenance, production deployments, software upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and incident recovery outside regular business hours when required.
* Ready to travel when required and able to collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams, vendors, service providers, and stakeholders.


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline
   

  

**Experience:**
 Minimum of 7\-10 years of experience in enterprise WAN network engineering, SD\-WAN, routing and switching, lifecycle management, or related network technology support.
   

  

**Certification Requirements:**
 CCNP Enterprise preferred; CCNA required. Versa certification and ITIL v4 are value adds.

title: Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**I\&O Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer**
**Supervising Associate \| Enterprise Technology**
**The opportunity**
 In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a proven Network Engineer to support and evolve EY's global data center and enterprise network infrastructure. The role will provide engineering, operational support, automation and lifecycle management across EY's campus, data center and wide\-area network environments. The successful candidate will work with cutting\-edge networking technologies with a specific focus on routing and switching, data center fabric, network security, SD\-WAN, load balancing and network automation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 The I\&O Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer provides technical support and engineering of complex nature for the firm's global enterprise network platforms. This professional applies knowledge of multi\-vendor routing and switching, data center networking, network security, WAN technologies and automation tooling to support enterprise\-scale connectivity and availability.
   

  

 The role requires in\-depth knowledge of the firm's network architecture to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, patching programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The engineer will assist in maintaining highly available, high\-performance network environments across global data center and office locations while ensuring compliance, resiliency and operational excellence.
   

  

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong experience designing and administering enterprise data center and campus network environments.
* Deep knowledge of routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP and IS\-IS.
* Strong Layer 2 switching experience including VLANs, STP, RSTP, MSTP and VPC/MLAG.
* Experience with Cisco, Arista or Juniper data center switching platforms (exclusionary).
* Experience maintaining mission\-critical production network environments in a global data center setting (exclusionary).
* Experience supporting SD\-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela, VMware VeloCloud or equivalent).
* Strong knowledge of network security technologies including:
+ Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA/FTD, Fortinet or equivalent)
+ Network Access Control (NAC)
+ IDS/IPS
+ VPN — IPsec and SSL/TLS
+ Microsegmentation

* Experience with data center fabric technologies including:
+ VXLAN
+ EVPN
+ Spine\-leaf architecture
+ ACI or equivalent SDN platforms

* Experience with load balancing platforms (F5 BIG\-IP, Citrix ADC or equivalent).
* Knowledge of DNS, DHCP and IPAM (DDI) management.
* Experience with network automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tooling including:
+ Ansible
+ Python / Netmiko / NAPALM
+ Terraform

* Experience with network monitoring and observability platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, ThousandEyes or equivalent).
* Ability to create technical documentation, network diagrams and operational runbooks.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**
* Enterprise routing and switching administration — 5–7 years.
* BGP, OSPF and other dynamic routing protocol configuration and troubleshooting — 5–7 years.
* Data center switching platforms (Cisco Nexus, Arista EOS, Juniper QFX or equivalent) — 5–7 years.
* Layer 2 technologies including VLANs, VPC, MLAG, STP and trunking — 5–7 years.
* Enterprise firewall administration (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD, Fortinet or equivalent) — 5–7 years.
* SD\-WAN deployment and operational management — 3–5 years.
* VXLAN/EVPN data center fabric design and administration.
* Spine\-leaf architecture deployment and operations.
* F5 BIG\-IP LTM/GTM load balancer administration.
* IPsec and SSL VPN configuration and troubleshooting.
* DDI management (DNS, DHCP, IPAM).
* Network automation scripting using Python, Ansible or equivalent.
* Network change management, patching and firmware lifecycle management.
* Network monitoring, alerting and capacity management.
* Packet capture and traffic analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump or equivalent).
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for network platforms.
* Security hardening and vulnerability remediation of network infrastructure.
* Cloud networking fundamentals — Azure Virtual Network, AWS VPC or equivalent.
* Hybrid connectivity including ExpressRoute, Direct Connect or equivalent (preferred).


**Ideally, you'll also have**
* Cisco CCNP (Enterprise, Data Center or Security) certification (desired).
* Arista ACE certification (desired).
* Palo Alto PCNSE certification (desired).
* Juniper JNCIP certification (better to have).
* F5 201 / 301 certification (better to have).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Cisco CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center) — better to have.
* Experience with network telemetry and streaming (gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig).
* Experience with Cisco ACI or VMware NSX SDN platforms.
* Familiarity with zero\-trust network access (ZTNA) frameworks and implementation.


**What We Look For**
 An experienced and technically strong network engineer to help build, maintain and modernize EY's global enterprise network infrastructure. We are looking for an individual with deep multi\-vendor networking expertise, a passion for automation and security, and the ability to support highly available, high\-performance network platforms while driving continuous operational improvement across EY's data center and wide\-area network estate.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
